item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Victorious Cast ft. Victoria Justice - Make It Shine (Official Music Video)
item.description:
Okay, so I've been swimmin' through the internet and I found out something...

So, back in the 2010s, Nick Australia broadcasted the Make It Shine music video. A full music video.

And looking at the comments, I found this video.

But searching even more, I found a good soul who uploaded the video in a better quality to Reddit.

But, it's still a phone recording of the broadcast.

So, what I wanted was: if you have any part of this video/the full video itself in a better quality or the capping of the broadcast, please send a link down here.

I'm trying to make a video putting various pieces together. Thank you anything. ;)
